summary: Pakistani payload specialist Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is part of the three-person Shenzhou-24 crew with commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi. The launch is scheduled for 25 November 2026 at 08:18 Beijing time (05:18 Pakistan time) on a Long March 2F rocket from the Jiuquan launch centre, with docking to the Tianhe core module of China's Tiangong space station planned about 3.5 hours after reaching orbit. He would be the first foreign astronaut to visit Tiangong and the first Pakistani on an orbital mission (Namira Salim flew a suborbital Virgin Galactic flight in 2023). He came out of a China-Pakistan astronaut agreement signed in early 2025, a selection in which two Pakistani candidates (Ali and Khurram Daud) trained in Beijing, and he flies as a payload specialist focused on experiments, including biotechnology experiments from Pakistani universities. He is expected to stay about a week and return to Earth with two Shenzhou-23 crew members, while one Shenzhou-23 astronaut stays for a year-long mission. NOTE: the launch had not happened when this was researched; confirm launch and docking before publishing.
audience: Pakistani families, students and young professionals who are proud and curious about Pakistan's first astronaut and want to understand how the trip actually works

facts.fact: The Shenzhou-24 crew is commander Tang Hongbo, flight engineer Wu Yi and Pakistani payload specialist Muhammad Zeeshan Ali.
facts.source: China Manned Space Agency news conference via Hong Kong Free Press / Reuters (24 Nov 2026)

facts.fact: Launch is scheduled for 25 November 2026 at 08:18 Beijing time (05:18 Pakistan time) from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on a Long March 2F rocket. (Must be confirmed after launch.)
facts.source: Hong Kong Free Press (24 Nov 2026); Wikipedia: Shenzhou 24

facts.fact: The primary plan is to dock with the Tianhe core module about 3 hours 30 minutes after entering orbit.
Ali would be the first foreign astronaut to visit China's Tiangong space station.
He would be the first Pakistani on an orbital mission; Namira Salim, a Pakistani, flew a suborbital Virgin Galactic flight in October 2023.
China and Pakistan signed an astronaut cooperation agreement in early 2025 covering selection, training and flights to China's space station.
Two Pakistani candidates, Muhammad Zeeshan Ali and Khurram Daud, were selected and trained for months at China's astronaut training centre in Beijing; only one would fly.
facts.source: Express Tribune; Geo News; Arab News (Sep 2026)

facts.fact: As a payload specialist, Ali's main job is running scientific experiments rather than flying the spacecraft.
A SUPARCO official said the mission aims to host biotechnology experiments developed by Pakistani universities.
Ali is expected to spend about a week on Tiangong and return to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft with two of its crew.
facts.source: Hong Kong Free Press; Wikipedia: Shenzhou 24

facts.fact: One Shenzhou-23 astronaut is staying aboard for China's first year-long orbital stay, which frees the seat for Ali's return.
Tiangong is China's permanently crewed space station; its core module Tianhe was launched in 2021 and the station was completed in 2022 with the Wentian and Mengtian lab modules.

Stating the launch or docking happened before it is confirmed
Inventing personal biography details (rank, hometown, education) not in sources
Political framing about China-Pakistan relations or other countries
